Aria (CS): Heads-up: VerdantCare kickoff tomorrow 11:00 AM PT. Account health = watch (trial active, low throughput but sporadic latency spikes). Renewal ~38 days. Need a concise customer-facing runbook: warmup, prefetch, batching profile, streaming fallback, and a one-click feedback capture.

Diego (Eng): Suggested minimal config: delta prefetch for top-6 prompts, continuous batching with target 22ms/token, max batch size 12, enable streaming with small chunks (256 tokens) and graceful close-on-error. Recommend synthetic warmup 30m prior with 30 concurrent requests. Example curl warmup: 
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/route/verdant-prod/warmup \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -d '{"prompt":"sample prompt"}' &
```

Rina (SRE): Add SRE guardrails: route timeout 5.5s, per-route error budget 2%/5m, slow-start limit 80rps for first 15m. Alert: `redwood_route_error_rate{route="verdant-prod"} > 2% for 5m`. Canary: route `verdant-prod-canary` -> smaller model.

Noah (PM): I'll make the customer checklist and own feedback capture. Post-call form: 3 questions (latency, correctness, blockers) + optional comments. I'll attach a short form link to the post-call email and tag CRM with sentiment.

Aria (CS): Can WarmupBot schedule the job and capture first-token latency samples so we can show the customer improvement graph during the call?  I want logs too.

WarmupBot: Warmup scheduled by Diego: id=wv-1766789012, run_at=2026-06-15T10:30:00Z, concurrency=30, route=verdant-prod. Logs available at /warmups/wv-1766789012. :white_check_mark:

Diego (Eng): For private deploys recommend KV cache 512MB, prefix_TTL 8m, and quantized int8 model where acceptable. For hosted: use r4 serving profile with reserved burst capacity for the 20m window. Also set max_async_prefill=48.

Rina (SRE): I'll add Prometheus snippets to the runbook and a shortpager if p95 > 900ms for 4m. Runbook action: if errors spike, flip traffic to `verdant-prod-canary` and initiate rollback.

Noah (PM): Action items: I own feedback form & CRM tagging, Diego schedules warmup and posts final script, Rina adds alerts & pager, Aria runs the pre-call checklist 20m before and shares the customer-facing checklist.

Aria (CS): Perfect. I'll paste the customer-facing checklist in this thread later today and ping the CE lead. Thanks everyone.
